mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS planId, p.drug_name AS drugName, p.dosage AS dosage, p.frequency AS frequency, p.take_relation AS takeRelation, p.remind_times AS remindTimes, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate, p.expire_date AS expireDate, p.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, p.stock_unit AS stockUnit, p.status AS status, p.deleted AS deleted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medication_log l WHERE l.plan_id = p.id) AS totalLogs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medication_log l WHERE l.plan_id = p.id AND l.status = 'TAKEN') AS takenLogs FROM medication_plan p JOIN elder e ON e.id = p.elder_id WHERE p.elder_id = #{elderId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND (p.deleted = 1 OR p.status = 0) ORDER BY p.id DESC
